title: Malicious code in loadferry (PyPI)
description: The loadferry package on PyPI version 0.1.0 is part of a coordinated malicious campaign involving loader packages that download and execute remote malicious scripts. Although the package itself does not contain the payload, its functionality enables execution of potentially harmful code from external sources.
aiSummary: This threat involves the loadferry package (version 0.1.0) on PyPI, identified as part of a campaign distributing loader packages designed to execute code fetched from remote URLs. The packages do not embed malicious payloads directly but facilitate the execution of remote malicious scripts, indicating a coordinated effort to provide multiple deceptive methods for loading malicious code. The campaign is categorized as malicious with intent similar to infostealers.
aiImpact: The package enables the execution of remote malicious scripts, which can lead to unauthorized code execution on systems where the package is installed. This can result in compromise of system integrity, data theft, or further malware deployment depending on the remote payload.
